title: Artificial intelligence: A powerful paradigm for scientific research

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence: A powerful paradigm for scientific research》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】The aim of this paper is to provide a broad research guideline on fundamental sciences with potential infusion of AI, to help motivate researchers to deeply understand the state-of-the-art applications of AI-based fundamental sciences, and thereby to help promote the continuous development of these fundamental sciences.
